authorship: Hand-authored write-scheduling and revision-safety witnesses over docs/A1_RECOVERY_CONTRACT.md section 4. Expected observations describe injected fake adapter/clock logs; no production persistence code exists or was consulted.

cases.title: A mutation marks recovery pending immediately

expected.law: The pending mark is synchronous with the mutation; the write itself waits for the idle window.

cases.title: One idle window produces exactly one write at 400 ms

expected.law: The snapshot is serialized for the triggering revision at queue time.

cases.title: Continuous editing flushes by the two-second maximum

expected.law: Repeated 300 ms mutations keep resetting the idle window; the two-second ceiling forces one write of the newest revision.

cases.title: A newer trigger replaces a queued-but-unstarted snapshot

expected.law: At most one write is in flight; a queued snapshot that has not started is replaced by the newer revision rather than queued behind it.

cases.title: An older completion cannot mark or overwrite newer state
cases.scenario: The write for revision 4 completes after revision 6 already exists.

expected.law: Completion may mark recovery clean only while its revision is still current.

cases.title: A visibility change requests one final best-effort write

expected.law: Correctness never depends on asynchronous work completing during unload.

cases.title: Quota exhaustion keeps editing and reports an actionable status

expected.law: Storage denial is an ordinary actionable state; the in-memory document is untouched.

cases.title: A denied write leaves both slots byte-for-byte unchanged

expected.law: A failed or refused adapter write can never leave the slots partially rotated.

cases.title: A successful current write atomically demotes the prior current
cases.scenario: Revision 3 is current; the write for revision 8 succeeds.

expected.law: Rotation happens inside the adapter write; readers can never observe two currents or zero candidates mid-write.

cases.title: A clean completion updates the clean revision exactly once

expected.law: The clean revision equals the written revision, and the status renders the frozen vocabulary with only the {time} substitution.
